title: ISO/IEC 42001 — AI management system, Annex A controls

controls.title: Logging of AI system operation
controls.note: The dated record set is the operation log this control asks to exist. Its retention and review are managed elsewhere.

controls.title: Access management
controls.note: A baseline inventories the permission rules and tool scopes actually configured in the environment. Without one, nothing here describes the access surface at all.

controls.title: Human oversight design
controls.note: The same artifact art. 13 relies on: the authorising words, recorded per run, plus the recorded deviations and rollback state beside them.

controls.title: AI system impact assessment
controls.note: Each PROPOSAL carries a classification decided against scope, risk, reversibility and evidence quality. This reports that the classification exists; clause 8.2 still requires a documented risk analysis linking risks to the controls selected, which is human work no tool performs.
